title: Show HN: I trained a 125M model to autocomplete piano on-device
guide_zh: 训练一亿两千五百万参数模型实时续弹钢琴，用 MIDI 音符作为音乐提示。
author: simedw
excerpt: I trained a 125M-parameter transformer to autocomplete piano performances in real time (~108 notes/sec on an iPhone 15). The idea is basically GitHub Copilot or Tabnine, except instead of prompting it with code, you prompt it by playing a few notes on a MIDI piano. The model then continues what you played, entirely on-device. The app is free if anyone wants to try it. Happy to answer questions about the model, training, Core ML, or the many things that didn't work.
